name: Least even positive integer k that does not appear in the first n prime gaps.
comment: Erdős asks if a(n) or even a(n)/log(n) tends to infinity (see Erdős Problems link).
example: For n = 3 the first three prime gaps are {1, 2, 2} so 4 is the least even positive integer that does not appear in this set.
author: _Giorgos Kalogeropoulos_, Nov 18 2025
